139: Allen is the main hero of the series. He was abandoned by his biological parents because of the supposed "deformity" of his left arm (which was later revealed to be caused by his Innocence).
140: A member of the fictional religious organization known as the Black Order. Kanda is a young and handsome Japanese man usually found in any mood that isn't positive. Kanda comes across as cold, stoic, and arrogant, even to his fellow exorcists.
141: Komui's younger sister, and assistant Head Officer. Her parents were killed by an Akuma when she was very young. Because she is an Accommodator, the Black Order took her away from her only remaining family member (Komui) to Headquarters against her will.
142: He is the Head of the Science Division at the Black Order headquarters and the older brother of Lenalee Lee. A young genius scientist, he holds the highest rank among the Order's support staff. Within the Order, he is typically seen wearing a white coat and slippers.
778: Tyki's powers stem from his ability to selectively interact with his surroundings. This allows him to become effectively intangible, passing through all manner of matter as a ghost would, or walk on air.
779: A cheerful Exorcist of mixed race, who aims to become a Bookman and is working along the Black Order just to be close to the events that must be seen. To help him, he developed an incredible memory: he is able to memorize every single aspect of something he saw.
780: Road Kamelot is the first Noah introduced in the D. Gray-man series, appearing to Allen, Lenalee, and Miranda in the Rewinding City arc. Despite looking as if she is in her early teens, Road is referred to as the oldest of the Noah.
857: Miranda Lotto is a 25-year-old German woman whose clock caused time to rewind in her town after she connected with Innocence inside it. She often feels inferior and useless and has been fired from over one hundred jobs. This contributes to her chronic depression.
858: A mysterious figure who has been operating from the shadows of human history for over 7,000 years.
2283: Allen's teacher, a scientist, and also one of the five Exorcist Generals. Currently, he has gone on a journey and has stopped corresponding with HQ for four years.
2320: Full name Arystar Krory III, he is a man with split personalities: His soft, kind, and overly-emotional side, and his "battle-mode" side. You can easily tell when he switches between either personality by his expressions.
3154: An old man who records the hidden history. He comes from the Bookman clan and doesn't have a name. Instead, he simply introduces himself as "bookman" during his first meeting with Allen.
3155: An exorcist from Bodrum who, despite his love of playing pranks on the other members of the order (i.e. using his Innocence to crack Tiedoll's glasses), was described by Tiedoll as "a good kid.
5161: One of the descendant Noah and a follower of the Millennium Earl Another descendant of Noah who's assigned to kill Froi Tiedoll (the General being escorted by Kanda and Marie) who has also come to Japan.
5229: The blonde female Noah, who wears a black suit with a blue tie and often wears black shades. Originally appeared at the Noah Dinner Party with the first few revealed Noah. She recently appeared in the manga again.
6711: Bak Chang is a 29-year-old Chinese descendant of a German wizard, one of the founders of the Black Order. He is also the leader of the Black Order's Asia Branch, a post occupied also by his great-grandfather.
6712: Fou is the guardian deity of the Black Order's Asia Branch, sealed by Bak's great-grandfather. Although she is not human, she often takes on a humanoid form to talk with others. Fou found Allen's body after Tyki Mikk's attack and took him to the Asia Branch headquarters.
6713: Wong is the Chief Minister of the Black Order's Asia Branch and seems to be the right-hand man of Bak Chan. He is very emotional and cries often.
6714: Klaud Nine is the only female General. Formerly an animal trainer in a circus, she seems to be a kind and gentle woman, as she is seen weeping for Sol Galen, Tina Spark, and Gwen Frere who were killed searching for her.
6715: Winters Sokaro is one of the five Exorcist General. He is a harsh man who wears a metal mask on his head. He displays a sadistic love of battle and shows an unsettling joy while he is killing. He shows very little compassion for others.
6858: In charge of the Science department of the Black Order, therefore he is technically the "boss" of the science department, but still carries out Komui's orders (though he does protest). He is Australian, and 26 years old.
7099: One of three surviving crew members of Anita, Chaoji was seen reacting with Innocence, which was sent into the ark by Tiedoll when Lenali fell into the arc, and so was able to become an exorcist.
7905: Know more commonly as Chomesuke, Sachiko is a level 2 Akuma who once served Millennium Earl. Although Sachiko appears to be a male Akuma, she is female in human form, who infatuates Lavi. At some moment, she crossed paths with Marian Cross and was converted by him.
8940: Mimi is Lulubell's faithful akuma who appears to be a young girl and have light blue (almost white) hair and wears a maid's costume. She is also often seen polishing Lulubell's nails.
9032: He appeared early on as a figure deeply connected to the protagonist, Allen Walker. For Allen, he was the person who taught him the street performance skills that became his livelihood and gave him his name, making him essentially a foster father.
9631: One of the five Exorcist Generals, a cheerful and easygoing man. Tiedoll is an artist who is always seen carrying a drawing pad and charcoal, who never turns down the opportunity of a beautiful view and seems to be able to draw very complex scenes from memory.
11918: Acting as a manager of a brothel in China, this beautiful woman is, in fact, a supporter of the Black Order. She is as direct and strong woman, yet the sensible type, and has an immense crew that obeys her.
12745: A minor character that appears in episodes 14 and 15. She and her father are looking for the leaves of rebirth which is rumored to be able to bring the dead back to life.
12945: Malcom is a special inspector sent to Headquarters by the Order's administration at the Vatican after General Cross and the other Exorcists return with the Ark. He is a tall man who speaks to intimidate those around him.
13293: A talking umbrella that belongs to the Earl and the Noah clan. Lero is often used as a toy, by the Noah Road. Lero posesses great magical powers,but he only uses them when the Earl tells him to do so.
14010: Lou Fa is an junior researcher at the Asian Branch of the Black Order. She has a crush on Allen Walker, but is shocked when Fou imitates her appearance and flirts with him.
14527: One of the Exorcists from Tiedoll's group. Noise Marie seems to be a tough, silent man. His innocence, "Noel Organon" (聖人ノ詩篇, "Noel Organon"?), gives him an incredibly strong hearing, allowing Marie to hear very low or very distant sounds.
14675: Link is also a special inspector sent to Headquarters, although he appears to be more of an administrative assistant to Lvellie. He has light colored hair which is cut short in front but extends to a braid in the back.
15453: Rikei is a researcher at the Asian Branch of the Black Order as well as Lou Fa and Shifu.
16480: A finder that accompanies Lenalee through saving the girl Jessica's mother. He is cowardly in the beginning, but after seeing the courage of Lenalee and Suman, he becomes inspired. When he parts ways with Lenalee and follows Suman, he seems to be a much stronger character.
17437: A doll in the ruin city of Mater, Italy. She continued moving for 500 years after the city fell. She is attached to Guzol, as he was the only human to accept her for what she is.
17924: Shifu is an apprentice of the Science Department at the Black Order's Asian Headquarters along with Likei and Lou Fa.
19648: The host to an innocence fragment that resides in a crystal ball, her ability is to predict the future. Allen and co first met her in China on their mission to find Marshall Cross.
20348: Eliade is a level two akuma. She is Arystar Krory's one and only love. She's blonde and usually has twintails. She's quite obsessed with beauty, make-up, and shopping. Although her beauty let her become a popular woman, her akuma nature always makes her feel ugly.
20968: He originally joined the Black Order five years before the storyline to pay for his daughter's medical fees. After being sent on a mission to find General Zokalo, his teammates Chaker Rabon and Kazanna Reed are killed by Tyki Mikk.
24132: Hevlaska is said to be the "Guardian of the Cube" and has been part of the Black Order since its establishment. She is completely enveloped by her Innocence, which seems indefinitely invoked.
29519: The little girl who payed Sumon to help retrieve her sick mother from the village in the woods.
30043: Eshi is the first Level 3 Akuma shown in the D.Gray-man series and one of the few Akuma to be given a name. Eshi explains that in a previous life he was an artist, hence his habit of making a frame with his hands prior to an attack and proclaiming "TITLE!
30231: The more submissive of the twins, Jasdero is also male and not female like first glances can lead one to believe. Jasdero closely resembles a rag doll due to his wide eyes and his mouth, which has the appearance of being sewn on the sides.
30232: The more dominant member of the twins. Debitto looks like a rebellious teenager, but because he stays in his Noah form, he is constantly dark-skinned, wears heavy makeup around his eyes and has the stigmata on his forehead. He wears a singlet, pants, and a leather jacket over it.
30379: Toma is seen on Kanda and Allen's first exorcist mission. He is injured after the Akuma has taken on his form while he took Allen's. Causing Kanda to attack him instead. He most often calls Allen, "Master Walker".
30856: The Head Cook of the Black Order. He is Indian, and of unknown age; "Jerry" is just his nickname. He knows Muay Thai, Thai-style kickboxing, and growing up, he knew he would inherit his family's dojo from his father, but Jerry never wanted it.
33024: An Indian young man who was friends with Allen. Appears in the episode "My Master, General Cross"
33971: The oldest of the five Generals, Yeegar is also a hero who puts himself on the front-lines for the first battles. According to Komui and others, he is very strict when it comes to manners and speech, however, he is a very kind person.
36358: Johnny Gill is a former member of the Black Order and a scientist in the European Branch's Science Section - division 1 where he was the assistant of section chief Reever Wenhamm.
38789: Jake Russell is an anime only character who works very dedicatedly for the Black order. He appears in a few episodes but is only a major role in episode 18 where he goes to town alone with Lenalee, much to Komui's chagrin.
40678: A guy who is living in Tyki Mikk's card. Inside the card there is a room full of names on the walls who Tyki Mikk's suppose to kill. Cell Roron's job is to wash off the names who are dead to keep him on track of his work.
79925: She appears in episode 18, though she is spoken of from episode 17. She is the daughter of the Sardini family. She is kidnapped by Vittorio but later admits that she wanted to be taken away by him because she didn't want to marry the Viscount of the Paletti family.
